review and merge this PR: 

<pasted_content id="a976">
I opened [Orb-agent/micro-intent#10](https://github.com/Orb-agent/micro-intent/pull/10) into `develop`. It fixes four of the five blockers, one commit each. The suite passes with no API keys (105 tests). The accept path with a real Google token hasn’t been tested yet; that needs you to sign in.

* Tests on a clean clone: the Google packages are now in `pyproject.toml`/`uv.lock`, `requirements.txt` is gone, and the Gemini client is only created when first used.
* Made-up flight data: without SerpApi, flight search returns an empty list plus the Google Flights link. The Gmail reservation parser leaves unparsed fields empty instead of filling in LX 1820 / K7Q2ZP, and skips hotel or concert “bookings”.
* Read-only agent: the send-email, create-event, create-task and create-doc tools are removed. The prompt now treats tool results as untrusted.
* Real auth: each token is checked once with Google and accepted only if it was issued to your `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID`. I ran this with your root `.env`: junk tokens get 401 on `/api/maps/search` and `/api/plan`, and `/health` stays open. If `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID` is missing, the API refuses requests with 503 rather than letting them through.

To check the accept path, start the server from the worktree with your `.env`, open `localhost:8000/docs`, click Connect Gmail, and run `/api/gmail/messages`. It should return 200. Port 8000 must be listed as an authorized JavaScript origin on your OAuth client.

```
cd /Users/macbook/Documents/GitHub/micro-intent/.claude/worktrees/google-fixes/backend && uv run --env-file /Users/macbook/Documents/GitHub/micro-intent/.env uvicorn main:app --port 8000
```

Not in this PR:

* The fifth blocker: `main.py` is still a separate backend outside docs/contracts.md. Fixing it means changing the contract, which AGENTS.md says needs the team’s agreement.
* The non-blocking review findings: these are listed in the PR description.

The repo has no CI checks, so nothing runs on the PR. The branch is `feature/wp2-google-integration-fixes`, following the AGENTS.md naming rule.
</pasted_content id="a976">

{"baseRefName":"develop","body":"Fixes the blockers from the [review of #6](https://github.com/Orb-agent/micro-intent/pull/6#pullrequestreview-5479203498), one commit each.

## Changes
- **Tests run on a clean clone.** `google-api-python-client` and `google-auth` move from a stray `requirements.txt` (deleted) into `pyproject.toml`/`uv.lock`. `LumiAgent` builds its Gemini client on first use, so `main.py` imports without `GEMINI_API_KEY`.
- **No invented flight data.** Without SerpApi, or when it fails, `search_flights` returns `flights: []` and the Google Flights link instead of three hard-coded flights. The Gmail reservation parser no longer fills in LX 1820 / ZRH–LIS / PNR K7Q2ZP: unparsed fields stay `None`, and emails with no flight details (hotel or concert "bookings") are skipped.
- **Read-only agent.** Removed the `gmail_send_email`, `calendar_create_event`, `tasks_create_task` and `docs_create_document` tools. The agent reads untrusted email, so one crafted message could have made it send mail as the user. The prompt now says tool results are untrusted. This follows work-packages.md rule 7.
- **Real auth on `/api/*`.** `get_current_token` used to accept any string after `Bearer`. It now checks the token once with Google's tokeninfo (POST, so the token stays out of URLs), accepts it only if `aud`/`azp` is `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID`, and caches it until it expires. If `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID` is unset it fails closed with 503.

## Not in this PR
- **The separate `main.py` backend is still outside `docs/contracts.md`.** Moving Maps/Flights into the contract agent, or documenting `main.py` in the contract, needs agreement per AGENTS.md rule 2.
- **Non-blocking findings from the review**, each a separate small fix:
  - `async def` endpoints run blocking calls
  - SerpApi one-way `type=2`, `travel_class` and `adults`
  - PNR regex with IGNORECASE
  - IATA codes matched inside words
  - `/api/chat` ignores `history`
  - "Actions completed successfully." fallback reply
  - Places `location` bias
  - live network calls in service tests

## Validation
- `uv run --locked pytest -q` with no API keys set: **105 passed**.
- Mutation check: with the token check disabled, 3 of the 4 `test_google_token_verification` cases fail.
- Live check against Google's tokeninfo using the repo-root `.env`: a junk token gets 401 on `/api/maps/search` and `/api/plan`, and `/health` returns 200.
- **Not yet checked:** the accept path with a real token. Open `/docs`, click Connect Gmail, then run `/api/gmail/messages`. It should return 200.
